notes.title: Dev Update: #04
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]
Welcome to the Freakout game [b]devlog![/b] and hope you guys are doing great and safe in this pandemic thing!

I know many of you are waiting for the game release and looking forward to playing. Thanks for [b]Wishlisting[/b] my game and showing your support and interest in this game. I know you guys are interested in the current status of the game. So here it is. I have been working hard on adding some features to make the gameplay fun and scary. I'm currently working on adding more rooms and places to play hide and seek to make the gameplay interesting and enjoyable.

This is the overall view of the house in wireframe mode (to make it visible for you as the entire map is dark) which I'm working on and the appearance may vary as I'm constantly trying to improve it by adding more rooms and stuff for the final version of the release.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37931666/f349d7717e7dea174835069d249467a4b0795706.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37931666/1c221c49f4d3f2a848acb832d296d8537366db64.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37931666/26f4561fb837eeb72d2c08a6eb4e7f70c5b5ad02.png[/img]
I hope you all enjoy the final version of the level.

I also added some moth (at first I thought it was a type of butterfly but unfortunately it was an insect ) that swarms the light in the night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37931666/955527968abd91248802b64aeb47739549eac345.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37931666/eb3cfe17783b2752b84fb003d4f7e06849fa4ecf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37931666/1185de4a6d631275cf32da631cbf816ad2daa086.png[/img]


I hope you all enjoy the final version of the game. Till that I continue to post more DEV updates possibly every week, so keep on checking in. Thank you all for your support!


If you are interested in more game dev stuff and if you have any ideas or suggestions to improve the gameplay experience please feel free to DM me.

Also, don't forget to [b]Wishlist[/b] the game if you are interested in the game to get notified during the release.

Discord: https://discord.gg/GmQAJRXr

Have a great day and stay safe. ~Janner

notes.title: Devlog 0 ~JannerBros
notes.notes:
[h3]Devlog 0[/h3]

Adding a new greenhouse to the map and I'm still working on it. I'm planning to add more creepy things inside the greenhouse, which might surprise you when playing the game. I hope you all enjoy this multiplayer horror. Been working on this game for the past 6 months and  I'm doing more experiments and research to make the map more unique and terrifying to play and so the designing part is taking more time. And the release date will be announced soon. I don't just want to "make a game" .... I want to make a "Great Game". Thanks for all of your support and interest for this game. It really means a lot to me. 
Have a great day and stay safe! 
~Janner
